title: An Act to Promote Accredited Institutions of Higher Education in Maine by Removing Requirements for Supplemental Guide Signs on the Interstate Highway System

summary.text: This bill removes the location and enrollment requirements that a college or university must meet to appear on a supplemental guide sign on the interstate highway system.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310
